laat_vaar.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Swaar' suits hardship; for remembering, 'moeilik' is the natural word.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Dit was swaar om te onthou' is natural spoken Afrikaans in a story and carries the burden of months of medicine as well as the remembering; 'moeilik' narrows it to the remembering only and spends the story's voice.

laat_vaar.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Loop' for a disease is loose and colloquial; 'versprei' says plainly how it spreads without changing the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Loop' is the ordinary Afrikaans idiom for how a disease passes from person to person, and the original reads well. This sentence carries the checked claim on how TB spreads, so a sideways word swap is not worth the risk.

laat_vaar.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
laat_vaar.voor: Die kliniek gaan wel elke hoes van twee weke of langer na.
laat_vaar.na: Die kliniek ondersoek wel elke hoes van twee weke of langer.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A clinic 'ondersoek' a cough; 'nagaan' reads like checking a document, and the protected wording stays intact.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Nagaan' (check) and 'ondersoek' (examine) are not the same action: the swap changes what the clinic is said to do with a two-week cough, and 'nagaan' fits the next sentence, 'Hulle kyk liewer te vroeg as te laat'.

laat_vaar.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
laat_vaar.na: Ma het tot die einde geluister
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Klaar geluister' is clipped spoken usage; 'tot die einde geluister' says more clearly that she heard the whole story first.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Klaar geluister' is natural Afrikaans and says exactly that she heard Palesa out first; the proposal is longer and only reads differently.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Jy kan gerus vroeër kom as jy bekommerd is
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Not a fault to fix, only noted: the paragraph reports the nurse's words ('Die suster het gesê ...', 'Sy het bygevoeg dat ...') and then switches to direct address with 'Jy'. It reads acceptably as free reported speech, so it is left as protected.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Onder die boom by die hek
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: toe oorgestap na Oom Frans se hek
laat_vaar_vorige.na: toe na Oom Frans se hek oorgestap
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In standard written Afrikaans the prepositional phrase comes before the past participle at the end of the clause.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Placing the directional phrase after the participle is natural Afrikaans in a story; the reordering is a lateral move.
